extracted.name: Stewed Apples
extracted.description: You can use any type of apple to make this simple stewed apple recipe, but sweeter varieties will add natural sweetness and flavor.
instruction_lines: Pour water into a large skillet. Arrange apple slices in the skillet. Add brown sugar, maple syrup, cinnamon, and vanilla extract to the skillet; stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer and reduce heat to low. Simmer, stirring from time to time, until apples have reached desired tenderness, 20 to 30 minutes.
